methods.name: TL-Mask R-CNN (Transfer learning Mask R-CNN)
methods.summary: A transfer learning-based Mask R-CNN architecture that uses weights pre-trained on new landslide data to detect old landslides and ice avalanches. It freezes most parameters, trains only the functional network, and incorporates data augmentation to handle small sample sizes.
methods.verbatim: we proposed a transfer learning Mask R-CNN (TL-Mask R-CNN) to detect old landslides and ice avalanches with distinctive features in optical images based on the characteristics of the new landslides... we combined TL and Mask R-CNN for old landslide detection and proposed the transfer learning-Mask R-CNN (TL- Mask R-CNN).

availability.author_statement: Full data availability statement, with shared links.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is linked via a GitHub repository, and the other input datasets are accessible through public providers. However, the custom TL-Mask R-CNN code is not provided or linked.
